name: p2-tanker-hoses
prompt: Heavy rubber hoses with brass couplings being connected to a bulk tanker truck's valve manifold: metal clunks, a coupling lever snapping shut and a short hiss. Close, outdoors. Length: 4 seconds

name: p2-tanker-pump
prompt: A bulk tanker truck's transfer pump running off its power take-off: a steady mechanical whine with liquid rushing through pipes and a big diesel idling underneath, continuous and unchanging. Outdoors. Length: 8 seconds

name: p2-tanker-relief
prompt: A pressure relief valve on a steel tank lifting and venting gas with a sharp hiss for a few seconds, then snapping shut. Outdoors. Length: 4 seconds

name: p2-tanker-leak
prompt: Liquid leaking steadily from a punctured steel tank onto gravel, a continuous gentle trickle and drip, unchanging. Outdoors. Length: 8 seconds

name: p2-tanker-purge
prompt: Compressed air blowing steadily through an empty steel tank, a hollow continuous rushing roar echoing inside it, unchanging. Length: 8 seconds

name: p2-tipper-rams

name: p2-tipper-slide-rock

name: p2-tipper-slide-bulk
prompt: Loose gravel and sand pouring out of a tipped dump truck body in one long rushing slide. Outdoors. Length: 5 seconds

name: p2-tipper-slide-standard
prompt: Heavy sacks and crates thudding one after another as they slide off a tipped truck bed onto the ground. Outdoors. Length: 4 seconds

name: p2-tipper-tailgate

name: p2-drillrig-setup

name: p2-drillrig-drill
prompt: A rotary drilling rig drilling into rock: a steady grinding rotary head, an air compressor roaring and flushing water gushing, continuous and unchanging. Outdoors. Length: 8 seconds

name: p2-drillrig-hammer

name: p2-drillrig-electric

name: p2-drillrig-chute

name: p2-drillrig-winddown

name: p2-survey-boom

name: p2-survey-console

name: p2-survey-array
prompt: A powered geophysical sensor array humming steadily, a low electrical hum with a faint slow pulsing, calm, continuous and unchanging. Outdoors. Length: 8 seconds

name: p2-survey-dish
prompt: A small motorised dish antenna turning slowly back and forth on its mount, a smooth gear motor whirr with gentle gear ticks, continuous. Outdoors. Length: 8 seconds

name: p2-survey-find

name: p2-genset-setup

name: p2-crawler-dive

name: p2-crawler-surface

name: p2-crawler-settle

name: p2-crawler-creak

name: p2-crawler-scrubber

name: p2-crawler-lab

name: p2-crawler-contact
